title: helm(private): fix values templating and init hooks for upgrade/rollback stability
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation: rolling upgrades of Redwood Private sometimes failed during post-install init jobs and produced schema validation errors when chart values used templating helpers. This caused failed upgrades and left initjobs in CrashLoopBackOff on customer clusters. This PR stabilizes the Helm chart by: 1) making values schema more explicit for init hook configs, 2) tightening templating guards around optional fields, and 3) making pre-upgrade hooks idempotent and rollback-safe.

This is a behavior-fix (no API changes). The description below lists the concrete changes, testing, and rollout notes.

What I changed: 
- values.schema.json: added explicit nullable/required keys for initJobs, tolerations, and kms/nodeselector blocks to avoid template deref errors when values are absent.
- templates/init-job.yaml.tpl: added hasKey/required checks and default empty arrays for tolerations/affinity so the templating engine never renders invalid YAML.
- templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-job.yaml: converted the hook to use a safe, idempotent check (create-if-not-exists labels + ownerReferences) and switched backoffLimit to 0 for fast fail and rollbacks.
- templates/hooks/post-rollback-cleanup.yaml: introduced a cleanup hook that removes dangling configmaps and initjob remnants created by interrupted upgrades.
- charts/_helpers.tpl: factored helper functions for safeGet/emptyList to reduce template repetition and improve auditability.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add schema entries for optional blocks
- [x] Add templating guards and helper functions
- [x] Make init hooks idempotent and add rollback cleanup
- [x] Add unit tests for Helm template rendering
- [x] Integration test on kind cluster with simulated interrupted upgrade

Testing: 
- Ran helm template against the following variants: minimal values, full enterprise values, and values with intentionally missing kms and tolerations. All variants render without template errors.
- Ran upgrade/rollback loop on a local kind cluster (k8s v1.26) to reproduce previous CrashLoopBackOff and validated hooks now complete or clean up appropriately.
- CI: chart linting and helm unit tests added; see CI status below.

Migration notes: 
- No breaking changes expected. Customers with custom values that relied on undefined behavior should be unaffected; if you used literal nulls in values for initJobs tolerations, the chart now treats them as empty lists.

Related: Linear ENG-3412, ENG-3398. See also internal incident INT-2025 for the customer rollback case that triggered this work.
